label: SAML identity provider
type: a SAML 2.0 identity provider used for Web-Console single sign-on, resolving to Server's own local RBAC roles and user groups. See idp:ldap's note on why this is not sso:realm.
note: Promoted with idp:ldap. The two are documented as mutually exclusive in one specific configuration pairing (native-ldap versus saslauthd), a hard constraint the registry has no good predicate for yet - doesNotSupport was built for a statement not supporting a construct, not for two configuration modes of one feature excluding each other. Left on the watchlist.
